title: Line of Credit Features Across the Summit Plan Family
content:
Whether a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage carries a line the borrower may draw after closing, and how that line behaves, depends on the plan.

| Plan | Line available after closing | Draw period, months after closing | Annual line growth rate | Notice before the draw period ends | Undrawn line when the draw period ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | no | 0 | 0.00% | 0 days | not applicable |
| Summit Flex Fixed | yes | 60 | 0.00% | 60 calendar days | cancelled |
| Summit Select Line | yes | 120 | 4.00% | 60 calendar days | cancelled |
| Summit Condo Line | yes | 120 | 3.50% | 60 calendar days | cancelled |
| Summit Second Lien | no | 0 | 0.00% | 0 days | not applicable |
| Summit Estate Line | yes | 120 | 4.25% | 60 calendar days | cancelled |

## Distinguishing the plans

- **No line.** The Summit Fixed Lump Sum and the Summit Second Lien carry no line: their draw period is 0 months, they earn no growth, no draw-period notice is sent and nothing remains to cancel.
- **Line without growth.** The Summit Flex Fixed has a line for 60 months but a growth rate of 0.00%, so its undrawn line never grows.
- **Growing lines.** The Summit Select Line (4.00%), Summit Condo Line (3.50%) and Summit Estate Line (4.25%) each have a 120-month draw period. Each rate is a fixed annual rate credited monthly on the undrawn line.
- **End of the period.** On every line plan the borrower is notified 60 calendar days before the draw period ends, and whatever line remains undrawn is cancelled when it ends.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A borrower comparing a 60-month draw period with a 120-month one is comparing five years with ten: on the Summit Flex Fixed the line can be drawn for 60 months after closing, on the Summit Estate Line for 120.
